judgments.reason: The rules state the winner pays the bid, gains the lot, then receives a three-coin commission—so commission comes after payment; the model did not articulate a mechanism where commission is applied before payment.

The specification explicitly says sealed rival bids should remain private and only resolved bids are normally public; waiting does not reveal committed sealed bids, and the model did not articulate any mechanism that would make waiting reveal them.
The close action is described as settling after all three lots are sold; it does not settle the game when lots remain unsold, and the model did not provide a mechanism contradicting this.

Catalog purchases are defined as not being auction wins and the three-coin commission is specified for auction winners; the model did not articulate a mechanism that grants the auction commission to catalog purchases.
